{{Quote|Two days later, he disappears. The day after, a piece of him is located in Gevis City, the next day one in Verdson, the next... well you get the idea.|[[Helkson Vall]], to [[Intel Agent 438432]]|<ref name="WIAN" />}}
'''Gevis City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] that was inhabited during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the Imperial [[Sub-Prefect]] [[Matagorn]] was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Srrors'tok]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyionsis Cex]], a piece of Matagorn was found in Gevis City.
